builder_to_prove: Define justified design-event and failure assumptions; Planner supplies no invented rain or infiltration data.
Demonstrate collection, retention, recovery and safe failure within parcel; finite dry containers alone are not proof.
Demonstrate no boundary discharge or public/neighbor harm; no unproven external collection operation or assumed rock infiltration.
external_service_interfaces.return_protocol: If the parcel-local strategy cannot be proved without violating fixed program/boundaries, return a new UPSTREAM_PLANNING_ISSUE with attempted bounded adaptations and minimum requested interface revision. Never silently create an outfall.

known_uncertainty.evidence: 151 parcel columns and near-ground snapshot available. No proposed block is below observed ground_y, but top natural blocks are replaced for some floors.
known_uncertainty.bounded_adaptation: No cellar or deep trench; separate shallow stepped plinths rather than whole-frontage platform.
known_uncertainty.minimum_closure: Review exact load/influence volume, ground contact and known artificial-content protections before foundation freeze. Do not treat shallow no-air evidence as deep clearance.

known_uncertainty.evidence: Two beds, cooking/living, daily storage, screened 2x2 sanitation, 18-cell yard and separate family route have dimensioned model geometry.
known_uncertainty.minimum_closure: Confirm household design occupancy; finalize door privacy/weathering, ventilation, flue and fire separation, native railing/screen collision. Two-bed study is not evidence of actual household size.
Explicit target/revision/hash authorization, land-use and common-easement agreement. This task requests no construction.
Actual clean-water source/quality/capacity, food/fuel delivery cadence, reserve and interruption response. Palette does not prove materials supply.
Waste destination/responsibility, closed carrying containers, clean/dirty time separation, and one-batch handheld work limit. No throughput claim.
Compile selected native block states, roof flashing/gutters, chimney lumen and doors; recheck supports, stairs and route collision. Custom review boxes are not an executable Canonical Blueprint.
Design and prove parcel-local collection/retention/recovery/safe failure; or return new UPSTREAM_PLANNING_ISSUE if infeasible.
Consume BDP-01 r3 and prove design fidelity to revised public and rainwater baselines; no gate result assigned by Planner.
